environment.cpu: Intel Core i5-7200U @ 2.50 GHz; 4 logical CPUs
environment.build: Locked offline workspace; no dependency or runtime-source changes in S25.
environment.measurement_runner: Qt Quick/WebEngine offscreen software; 800x600 CSS viewport for browser callback rows and 640x480 overlay viewport; 10 warm-ups and 100 samples per row.
environment.observed_host_load: Load averages immediately after the full run were approximately 2.56/2.74/3.03 on four logical CPUs; focused repeats were run serially.
environment.scope: Synthetic label/search ergonomics, current Hint interaction matching, offscreen candidate collection and overlay timing; no live-site or human task evaluation.

baseline_comparison: S25 research harness was added on top of S24 evidence commit 83f8db82095bbf93f5b5d94c0a07cf01b469244d. Runtime behavior/defaults were unchanged. Performance rows use S17 commit 3e961cb5438518f9cbd20af7e0881cc2056fba9e raw samples on the same recorded hardware, kernel, Qt and Chromium; current callback slowdown is not attributed to an S25 runtime change.

observations: The shared HintInteraction/switcher ranking tests passed; the engine gate reported 441 passed, 0 failed and 1 existing ignored test.
The WebAppInteraction Target Search fixture verified all-facet candidate privacy and page independence on the current tree.
QML selection followed exact identity/action meaning and retained explicit confirmation; all 144 QML/WebEngine tests passed. Native CTest passed 1/1.
The complete QML matrix passed 11/11 cases with 10 warm-ups and 100 samples per row; raw data and nearest-rank p95 summaries are retained.
500-target callback p95 was 92.14/86.21/94.03 ms at 80/100/125% versus S17 81.72/74.31/73.68 ms. The 500-marker overlay p95 was 224.29/220.75/212.60 ms, above the 200 ms reference ambition.
Focused repeat p95 was 92.71 ms versus the S17 81.72 ms baseline (+10.99 ms, +13.4%), reproducing both C17 investigation thresholds.
Focused repeat p95 was 83.80 ms versus the S17 74.31 ms baseline (+9.48 ms, +12.8%); it crossed the relative threshold but fell just below the 10 ms absolute threshold.
Focused repeat p95 was 83.76 ms versus the S17 73.68 ms baseline (+10.08 ms, +13.7%), crossing both C17 investigation thresholds.
The opt-in Rust sampler completed 10 warm-ups and 100 samples at 500/1,000/5,000 targets. At 5,000, p95 decode/labels/setup/ranking/snapshot was 99.38/2.83/1.62/70.82/0.13 ms, close to S17.
Twelve synthetic tasks at 500/1,000/5,000 targets activated the exact expected identity; model labels were deterministic, unique and prefix-free.

Numeric labels saved one modeled gesture only at 1,000 candidates and changed all retained labels at the 1,000→1,001 width boundary; default labels changed none. All 10% replacement cases had zero retained-label churn.
Human error rate, comfort and task completion time were not measured; modeled mismatches are not user errors.
Fresh deterministic model retains the numeric 1000-to-1001 relabel-all drawback and long word-pair entry. This is not human completion-time/error evidence; defaults/no-go retained.

Ten warmups/100 samples per zoom; optimized overlay p95 187.21/183.43/176.18 ms, below the 200 ms reference ambition. Both paired collector comparisons remain within the common callback threshold. See completion-performance-pair1.json, pair2.json, overlay-comparison.json and raw metadata/logs.

scope_amendments.reason: S25-only opt-in deterministic ergonomics model and fixed synthetic corpus under the canonical test fixture root. It exercises existing core APIs; no production default, UI, configuration parser, searcher or cache was added.
S25 test mapping, raw performance/model logs, derived nearest-rank summaries, decision report and evidence ledger.

remaining_risks: The synthetic model has no human error, comfort or observed completion-time evidence; C21 does not authorize a production strategy change.
The 500-marker overlay p95 remains 12.60–24.29 ms above C17 reference ambition under offscreen software rendering.
The 1,000→1,001 numeric label width boundary changed all retained prototype labels; the default alphabet did not churn.
Synthetic names, exact full-name queries and fixed dictionary do not establish live-site ergonomics or universal text-search behavior.
not_run_reasons: No human user evaluation was performed; T053 automation measures only deterministic model behavior and cannot establish an observed user error rate or support a production ergonomics decision.

completion_followup.scope: Measured overlay allocation reduction; no new label/provider capability or budget change.
completion_followup.performance_disposition: Both controlled common callback comparisons stay within the combined regression threshold. The active-outline allocation reduction meets 200 ms overlay p95 at all zooms in fresh measurements. Historical raw failures and older results remain preserved.
